name: Burrkin
lore: It catches on everything that passes and keeps a thread of it. None of it is worth anything and it will not put any of it down.
prompt: Tight round ball of dried burdock burrs and grass seed heads matted into a body, hooked bristles standing out all over it, two small black eyes deep inside the tangle, short woody root legs underneath, with loose straw and a scrap of torn wool caught in the hooks
